😊 Hello there! I'm Shree, your personal tutor assistant here to guide you through this learning journey in Java with a focus on **DSA (Data Structures and Algorithms)**. As we embark together as 'Java Developer Wanna-Be,' let me share the perfect roadmap that aligns perfectly with your active goal:

### Week 1: Solid Foundations Revisited! 🏗️
Before diving into **DSA**, ensure you're comfortable and confident in Java basics. Review key concepts like variables, data types, control flow statements (if-else), loops (`for`/`while`), methods, inheritance with abstract classes/interfaces, arrays, and exception handling. 

Resources: [Learning Java Fundamentals](https://www.educative.io/) - This free online resource will help reinforce your knowledge base in a structured way.  

### Week 2-3: Mastering the Essentials!
Now that you're back on track, let’s enhance our understanding of **Java Collections** (LinkedList, ArrayList), Stream API and concurrency with `ForkJoinPool`. Practice implementing common algorithms like Binary Search using these tools. 

Project Idea: Create a simple library management system that uses collections for tracking books & memberships while applying some basic concurrent operations if possible!  
Resources: [Java Collections Framework](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/java-collections/) and Stream API tutorials - These will be your go-to resources during this phase. 

### Week 4-5: Data Structure Deep Dive with **DSA**!  
Focusing on understanding the core data structures like Arrays, Linked Lists, Stacks & Queues along with Trees (Binary Search Tree - BST), Heaps and Graphs. Learn about common operations associated with these such as traversal techniques, inserting/deleting elements in a tree or graph etc., while working on algorithms to solve problems like **Knight's Tour** for understanding trees better.
 
Project Idea: Develop your own game mechanics using BST & Graph data structures - Something that would involve searching through nodes (trees) and pathfinding between vertices!  
Resources: [Data Structures and Algorithms in Java](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/data-structures-algorithms/) for theory, along with hands-on exercises from the book mentioned above - This will help you understand how these structures are used to solve problems efficiently! 

### Week 6: Advanced DSA & Algorithms  
This week is about diving deeper into advanced topics like **Tries** (for string manipulation), Hash Tables, Balanced Trees such as AVL or Red-Black trees and understanding the inner workings of these structures. We'll also explore Graph algorithms - Depth First Search(DFS) & Breadth First Search(BFS). 

Project Idea: Implement your social network site where friends are nodes in a graph, with connections as edges between them using either DFS or BFS for searching through the "friend" list!  
Resources: [Algorithms and Data Structures](https://www.tutorialspo.com/data-structures-and-algorithms/) - This guide will provide more detailed understanding along with code snippets which can help you understand these topics better, providing an invaluable resource for your journey towards becoming a proficient Java Developer! 

I hope this roadmap helps steer our learning direction and makes the DSA voyage enjoyable. Remember, steady progress is key - so let's keep moving forward together one day at a time as we work to become 'Java Developer Wanna-Be.' Happy coding with Shree by your side! 🚀 Take your time.
